content:
marta: Kicking off a quick canary 10% in eu-west for v2026.3.5 — FYI thread for stop/go.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] canary started: id=canary-4012 target=10% region=eu-west version=v2026.3.5
cheng: saw a small spike in 502s at ~02:32, taily. rolling avg 0.6% vs baseline 0.05% :thinking:
ryan: any infra alerts matching those times? cpu/mem/network?
ellen: ops: no host CPU/mem spikes. seeing redis timeouts on eu-w-3 around same window. grabbing logs.
marta: hold — pause traffic shift. tagging infra/redis @ellen @cheng. can we pin traffic back to v2026.3.4 while we triage?
ryan: +1 pin. deploy-bot, can you shift traffic back to previous version and drain canary?
deploy-bot: executing traffic shift -> canary_id=canary-4012 target=0% fallback_version=v2026.3.4
deploy-bot: shift complete. canary-4012 drained, traffic routed to v2026.3.4
cheng: quick grep: increased kv_cache MISS rate after tokenizer bump in v2026.3.5. not sure if redis errors are cascade.
marta: OK — treat as STOP. No further percent increases. eng-runtime to prep 2026.3.5-hotfix (revert tokenizer change or patch).
ryan: we should open a rollback/incident ticket for the change window and RCA, even though traffic was reversed.
ellen: ops will run redis failover & collect `redis-cli INFO` dumps from eu-w-3, eu-w-4. Will update when done.
marta: noted. ACTIONS: ENG: create hotfix branch + tests. OPS: redis checks. PM: hold release notes updates until hotfix validated. Marking change window as paused. :no_entry:
cheng: added Jira tasks INF-3421 (redis postmortem), ENG-7865 (tokenizer hotfix)
ryan: quickvote: stop rollout — thumbs-down to proceed.
marta: consensus STOP. We'll reconvene after infra signoff and hotfix QA. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
